# Lucide keyboard icons

The `i-shift` and `i-caps-lock` SVG symbols in `index.html` use the unmodified path data from Lucide:

- [arrow-big-up](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucide-icons/lucide/70562c1ee1c4fdcf736fe97bc893fb8511927934/icons/arrow-big-up.svg) for Shift.
- [arrow-big-up-dash](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucide-icons/lucide/70562c1ee1c4fdcf736fe97bc893fb8511927934/icons/arrow-big-up-dash.svg) for Caps Lock.

Source revision: `70562c1ee1c4fdcf736fe97bc893fb8511927934`. The original 24 × 24 viewBox, rounded strokes, and 2px stroke weight are retained. See [LICENSE](LICENSE) for the upstream license.

The floating shortcut handle uses the unmodified [command](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucide-icons/lucide/70562c1ee1c4fdcf736fe97bc893fb8511927934/icons/command.svg) path from the same revision.
